description: The DSL text of one diagram frame: what was authored while the canvas still matches it, else text regenerated from the canvas (`edited: true`). `canvasEdits` lists what was changed on the canvas against the authored text: recolours, moves, resizes, renames, icons, rewired or bent connectors, and shapes added or removed. Each has `carry`: attributes to merge into that node's existing `[ … ]` list (one list per node) to keep the edit, or null when the language cannot say it. `canvasEdits` is null, with `canvasEditsNote` saying why, when it could not be compared. `losses` names what the language cannot say at all. update_diagram drops anything the text you send does not carry.

documentId.description: File-mode document id from openflow_open or openflow_create; omit to use the paired editor (or, in file mode, the document opened or created last).

frameId.description: Diagram frame id, from create_diagram or list_diagrams. Defaults to the first diagram on the page.

pageId.description: Page to read (see list_pages); defaults to the page the editor shows, or the first page in file mode.

name: get_diagram
title: Read diagram
